dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent mid-lateral elongated 'C' structure with a dark defined perimeter transitioning to a lighter interior; an 'O' shaped structure positioned dorsally with a diffused gradient; and a series of interlocking, irregular circular perimeters spanning the mid-to-posterior dorsal section.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Clusters of high-intensity white pixels are concentrated in the anterior-ventral region, with secondary lower-density clusters of light-grey blobs distributed along the lower lateral midline.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: An obtuse triangle is formed by the centroids of the anterior high-intensity blob, the central 'O' annulus, and the posterior-most defined circular structure.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct vertical high-intensity pixel streak is located on the anterior head/neck boundary.
